title: Urgent Hiring for Sr. Architect
description:
We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented Architect to plan, design and oversee the construction of buildings and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing design concepts, preparing drawings, co-ordinating with clients and consultants and ensuring compliance with applicable codes and standards.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Develop architectural drawings, plans and 3D models using AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp or similar tools
* Co-ordinate with structural, MEP and interior design consultants
* Ensure designs comply with local building by laws, NBC and safety regulations
* Prepare project documentation, BOQs and specifications
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress and ensure design intent is followed
* Liaise with clients, contractors and authorities for approvals and modifications.
* Manage timelines, budgets and quality standards
* Review and approve shop drawings and material samples

**Qualification**

Bachelor's Degree in Architecture  
5+ years of relevant experience  
Proficiency in AutoCAD or similar software  
Strong understanding of construction methods and materials  
Knowledge of Indian building codes and local regulations

**Preferred skills**

Experience ins residential/commerical projects  
Knowledge of sustainable and green building practices  
Ability to manage multiple projects

title: Training and Placement Officer
description:
Senior Training & Placement Officer / Head – Training & Placements

**Engineering College**

**Qualification:** B.E./B.Tech with MBA / M.E./M.Tech; Ph.D. preferred  
**Experience:** 8–15 years of relevant experience, preferably in reputed Engineering Institutions  
**Reporting To:** Principal / Management

Key Responsibilities

* Lead the **Training & Placement Cell** and develop an annual placement strategy with measurable targets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with **reputed IT, Core Engineering, Manufacturing, Product, R&D and multinational companies**.
* Identify and onboard **new recruiters** and strengthen engagement with existing corporate partners.
* Drive **campus, pooled and off-campus recruitment** opportunities for eligible students.
* Develop a structured **placement training roadmap** covering aptitude, coding, technical skills, communication, GD and interview preparation.
* Analyse **branch-wise placement gaps** and implement suitable training and placement interventions.
* Establish strong **industry–institution partnerships** for placements, internships, projects, industry training, expert sessions and MoUs.
* Personally engage with **HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Leaders and senior corporate professionals** to generate placement opportunities.
* Lead and mentor the **Placement Officers, Trainers and Department Placement Coordinators**.
* Set and monitor KPIs including **placement percentage, number of recruiters, packages, internship conversions and student participation**.
* Ensure systematic follow-up from **company sourcing to offer release and final joining** of selected students.
* Develop opportunities for students in both **IT and Core Engineering sectors**, with focus on quality and higher-package placements.
* Prepare and present **weekly/monthly placement MIS and performance reports** to the Management.
* Maintain accurate documentation and placement evidence for **AICTE, NBA, NAAC, NIRF and accreditation requirements**.
* Benchmark placement performance with leading Engineering Institutions and continuously improve the institution's **corporate visibility and placement outcomes**.

Candidate Profile

A senior, result-oriented placement professional with **strong corporate connections, proven recruiter acquisition capability, leadership skills and a successful track record of improving Engineering College placements**.

**Preference will be given to candidates who can demonstrate an established recruiter network and measurable placement achievements in their previous institutions.**

**Preference will be given for candidates who are in and around or willing to relocate to Coimbatore (only)**

Work Location: In person

title: Senior HR Recruiter ( F only )
description:
**Job Title:** Senior HR Recruiter

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Location:** Kurumbapalayam, coimbatore

**Position Summary:**

The Senior HR Recruiter is responsible for leading full-cycle recruitment processes to attract and hire top talent across all departments. This role partners closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand workforce needs, develop sourcing strategies, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. The ideal candidate will be proactive, data-driven, and skilled at both strategic planning and hands-on execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage the **end-to-end recruitment process** including sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding candidates.
* Collaborate with department heads to **understand hiring needs** and develop effective recruitment strategies.
* Utilize multiple sourcing channels (LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, networks, etc.) to **identify and attract top talent**.
* Build and maintain a **strong talent pipeline** for critical and recurring roles.
* Conduct **competency-based interviews** and coordinate technical and final interviews with hiring panels.
* Partner with HR and hiring managers to **define job descriptions and role requirements**.
* Ensure a **positive candidate experience** throughout the recruitment process.
* Analyze **recruitment metrics** (time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, quality of hire) and present regular reports to management.
* Stay up to date on **industry trends and best practices** in recruitment and employer branding.
* Support **diversity and inclusion initiatives** in hiring practices.
* Mentor and guide junior recruiters or HR associates as needed.

**Qualifications & Skills:**

* **Bachelor’s degree** in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* **5–8 years of experience** in recruitment or talent acquisition ( preferred school or college is added advantages)
* Proven experience managing **high-volume and specialized recruitment**.
* Excellent **communication and negotiation skills**.
* Demonstrated ability to **build relationships** with stakeholders at all levels.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and planning
* Stakeholder management
* Decision-making and problem-solving
* Adaptability and time management
* Confidentiality and integrity

Salary: 30000 to 40000/-per month

title: On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist
description:
Location: Coimbatore
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742013
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**On\-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**


**(Senior Associate)**

  


**Enterprise Technology (ET)**



Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**



As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.



The On\-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists
* Provide after\-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues
* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately
* Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow\-up to ensure customer satisfaction
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.
* Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary.
* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.

  


**To qualify for the role you must have**


* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support

  


**What we offer**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
